children: Doubao denied online claims that it had carried out layoffs or cut its dialogue team in half after reports said its general Session team had undergone a staffing reduction. On September 24, according to ChainCatcher, the topic "Doubao employee says Doubao has become a marginal product" trended on Weibo.

Doubao public relations head Liu Xing said reports describing the change as layoffs were inaccurate and that the move was only an organizational adjustment in job responsibilities. He said part of the general Session team’s functions were split into Doubao Trading and Doubao Work teams, with related staff transferred accordingly.

Liu said many employees still work on dialogue experience-related tasks, including optimization on the trading side. He added that the team had fewer than 50 people, the role adjustment involved 11 employees, and 3 of them left the company. He also rejected claims that Doubao had laid off staff or cut its dialogue team in half.

title: Doubao Denies Layoff Claims After Session Team Reorganization
